purpose: Experiment E-FND-0080 in the foundations arena: the committed rule has no single-particle quantum sector: its vacuum is a global period-three flash, a seeded tone is a classical defect of at most two slots that never spreads, two defects add exactly as sets with zero cross term, while the coined Dirac walk seeded the same way spreads and interferes.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
